statement: Maha Parivartana Yoga (a mutual sign exchange between two planets that each rule a kendra or trikona house) is traditionally read as carrying a compounded, mutual elevation — each planet lending its strength to the other's good house, generally considered one of the most auspicious structural combinations.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
